fields.title: Digital Workplace Readiness
fields.subtitle: July operational assessment for Mint Leadership

claims: Incident volumes increased from 820 in April to 1120 in July.
Compliance, deployment and access gaps remain unresolved.
fields.pivot_question: Which actions should be prioritized to reduce operational risk?
fields.verdict: Targeted remediation proposals should focus on compliance, deployment, access and communication.

slides.action_title: Four metrics highlight current readiness constraints.

cards.title: Device Compliance
cards.body: 967 of 1240 devices are compliant. 273 devices remain non-compliant.

cards.title: Acrobat Deployment
cards.body: 1020 of 1240 deployments are complete. 220 deployments remain incomplete.

cards.title: Service Performance
cards.body: First-contact resolution is 68%, median access completion is 14 hours and satisfaction is 3.7/5.

slides.action_title: Incident volumes increased across four consecutive months.

fields.takeaway: 1120 incidents in July was the highest reported monthly volume.

slides.action_title: July results show mixed readiness outcomes.
Four risks require focused remediation proposals.

cards.title: Compliance Risk
cards.body: 273 devices remain non-compliant. Proposal: prioritize remediation of outstanding devices.

cards.title: Deployment Risk
cards.body: 220 deployments remain incomplete. Proposal: accelerate completion of remaining deployments.

cards.title: Service Risk
cards.body: Access delays and weak status updates persist. Proposal: improve workflow visibility and communication.

slides.action_title: A four-step plan can address current gaps.
Leadership alignment can accelerate readiness improvements.
